too_many.title: Too much food in the photo
too_many.message: There's too much food in this photo. Try one plate, or at most 3-4 items per photo, from closer up, with only the food you want to log in the frame.

unclear.title: Photo isn't clear
unclear.message: The photo is blurry or too dark, so the food is hard to recognize. Retake it in brighter light and hold the camera still until it focuses.

not_food.title: No food in sight
not_food.message: The AI couldn't find any food in this photo. Point the camera straight at the food, fill the frame with it, and try again.

timeout.title: AI took too long
timeout.message: The AI took too long to read the photo. Try again in a moment, or shoot one plate from closer up so it finishes faster.

failed.title: Couldn't analyze the photo
failed.message: The AI couldn't recognize this photo. Try another photo with better lighting.

fail.tooManyPartial: There was too much food in the photo, so the AI only logged the most prominent items. Use these, or retake one plate (3-4 items max) from closer up.

errors.storyInputRequired: Send text or a voice recording.
errors.anonAiUnavailable: The AI service isn't available yet.
errors.anonTrialUsed: Your free tries are used up. Sign up to keep scanning.

idle.title: Scan food
idle.heading: Point at your plate
idle.referenceHint: Tip: put a card (ATM/ID) or a kitchen scale next to your food so the portion comes out closer.
idle.tip: One plate per photo, up close

info.title: How it works
info.how: AI recognizes Indonesian dishes and counts the calories. You can correct the numbers before saving.
info.story: Forgot to take a photo? Just describe your meal, typed or by voice.
info.barcode: Packaged food? Scan the barcode and the nutrition comes from Open Food Facts.

privacy.kept: Your original photo is saved for you only. Change this in Profile.
privacy.notKept: The photo is only used for analysis and isn't saved.

camera.permissionBody: JoyoRogo needs camera access to photograph your food and count its calories with AI.
camera.hint: Snap your plate, AI counts the calories

flow.notImage: That file isn't an image. Pick a food photo (JPG/PNG/WebP).
flow.processFailed: Couldn't process the photo. Try again.
flow.captureFailed: Couldn't take the photo. Try again.
flow.analyzeFailed: Couldn't analyze the photo. Try again.
flow.priceInvalid: The plate price isn't valid (use a rupiah amount).
flow.pickOne: Select at least one food to log.
flow.photoLost: The scanned photo is gone. Retake it first.

food.gepreK: 1 serving of ayam geprek + iced tea

reaction.high: WHOA, you really eating all that, bro??
reaction.mid: Whoa, you really eating all that, bro??

result.title: Check AI results
result.photoCaption: Original photo and a cutout of each food

items.label: Recognized foods
items.title: What the AI saw
items.cupWhich: The cup's contents aren't visible. Pick what it is:
items.scaleReadShared_one: Read from the scale: {{value}}, split over {{count}} item
items.scaleReadShared_other: Read from the scale: {{value}}, split over {{count}} items

memory.title: Did you mean this?
memory.group: Swap the top item for a food you corrected before

info.title: About this result
info.retry: The AI re-reads the same photo without a retake and without using your daily quota.
info.feedback: Your answer helps improve future estimates.

keepPhoto.label: OK to keep this photo to help improve the AI
keepPhoto.hint: The photo is only used to test and improve the AI, and can be deleted if you ask.

retry.title: Numbers look off?
retry.exhaustedHint: This photo has been recounted twice. Retake it.
retry.hintPlaceholder: e.g. the rice is brown rice, half portion
retry.keepPrevious: The previous result is still shown.

done.title: Logged!
done.text: The food from the photo is in today's log.

paywall.title: Your free try is used up
paywall.bodyUnlimited: Sign up free to keep scanning with no daily limit, plus the diary, weight chart and your daily plan.
paywall.bodyLimit_one: Sign up free to continue. A free account gets {{count}} photo a day, plus the diary, weight chart and your daily plan.
paywall.bodyLimit_other: Sign up free to continue. A free account gets {{count}} photos a day, plus the diary, weight chart and your daily plan.

demo.hint: Photograph your plate from above, in good light.

empty.title: No food detected
empty.hint: Try a closer photo in brighter light.

demo.footer: Photos are only used for analysis, then discarded.

correct.title: Something off?
correct.hint: Type or say the fix, e.g. “half the rice”.
correct.micDenied: Microphone access isn't allowed. Turn it on in settings, or just type the correction.
correct.micUnsupported: This device can't record audio. Just type the correction.

error.unclear: I couldn't read that correction. Try phrasing it clearly, e.g. “half the rice”.
error.unknownReference: I couldn't find the item you mean. Name the food, e.g. “half the rice”.
error.emptyResult: That would remove every item. If the photo is totally wrong, retake it.
error.failed: Couldn't process the correction. Try again in a moment.
error.voiceEmpty: I couldn't hear that clearly. Try again or type the correction.
error.inputRequired: Send text or a voice recording.
error.scanLimit_one: You've used the correction limit for this photo ({{count}} time). Edit by hand or retake the photo.
error.scanLimit_other: You've used the correction limit for this photo ({{count}} times). Edit by hand or retake the photo.
error.dayLimit: Today's correction limit is reached. Edit by hand or try again tomorrow.
